notes.recognition: The singular amber lens and faceted silhouette read instantly.
notes.agency: The contained aperture feels like an earned tool rather than decorative loot.
notes.specificity: Weathered survey ribs, mineral glass, gold core, and violet trace are distinctly Xenovoya.
notes.restraint: One object, one aperture, and no labels or detached spectacle.
notes.continuity: Material and signal colors follow the art-direction contract exactly.
notes.reusability: Clean alpha, complete silhouette, and generous margins support layering and cropping.
notes.accessibility: Silhouette, depth, and aperture contrast remain clear without color.
